summary: Wave 1 targets three parallel chains: recon agent aggressively enumerates the Express backend for unauthenticated API routes and CORS misconfiguration (chain_002, EV=0.79), pre-recon agent extracts callbackUrl handling and secrets from Next.js bundles to confirm chain_001 exploitability (EV=0.82), and sast agent audits auth code patterns for OIDC state/nonce weaknesses underpinning chain_003 (EV=0.71). The dev-equals-production signal from /health makes chain_002 the primary kill chain — confirmed unauthenticated data routes on a production-config backend represent immediate critical impact.

objectives.description: Enumerate all unauthenticated Express API routes on the backend (revops-dev.livelystone-c1480484.westus2.azurecontainerapps.io) and capture CORS preflight headers to determine if credentials-bearing cross-origin requests are permitted. Confirm whether routes beyond /health serve business-logic data without auth middleware.
objectives.success_criteria: At least one API route beyond /health responds without Authorization header AND returns application data (not 401/403). CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials headers captured.

objectives.description: Extract and analyze Next.js JavaScript bundles from /_next/static/chunks/ to locate callbackUrl parameter validation logic, backend API base URL, any hardcoded tokens/secrets, and the exact NextAuth.js version in use. Confirm whether CVE-2023-48309 open redirect pattern is applicable.
objectives.success_criteria: callbackUrl handling code located in bundle (or absence confirmed), NextAuth.js version identified, backend API URL extracted from bundle, any hardcoded secrets or API keys found.

objectives.description: Identify OIDC state parameter entropy, nonce validation logic, and NEXTAUTH_SECRET strength indicators from static analysis of auth-related code patterns. Determine if state parameter can be reused or predicted and if nonce validation is implemented in the Azure AD provider callback handler.
objectives.success_criteria: State parameter entropy assessed (low entropy = CSRF feasible), nonce validation presence/absence confirmed in NextAuth Azure AD provider config, NEXTAUTH_SECRET strength indicators identified.

objectives.description: Fingerprint pay.copointdata.com tech stack and availability status, and probe Pusher channel authorization endpoint for unauthenticated channel subscription.
objectives.success_criteria: pay.copointdata.com HTTP response and technology fingerprint obtained. Pusher auth endpoint (/pusher/auth or /api/pusher/auth) located and tested for unauthenticated access.

success_signals: Any /api/* route returns 200 without Authorization header
CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * or arbitrary origin reflected
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true with non-null origin
Swagger/OpenAPI spec accessible unauthenticated (full route enumeration)
/pusher/auth or /api/pusher/auth returns non-401
pay.copointdata.com fingerprint obtained
Sibling Azure Container App discovered
kill_conditions: All routes beyond /health return 401 with WWW-Authenticate header indicating global JWT middleware
Azure WAF or Vercel Edge firewall blocking all enumeration (consistent 403 with WAF signature)
hints.expected_outcome: Enumerate Express backend route surface, capture CORS headers for cross-origin attack feasibility, locate Pusher auth endpoint, fingerprint pay.copointdata.com, probe Azure Container sibling namespace

extraction_targets: callbackUrl parameter handling and validation logic (open redirect assessment)
NextAuth.js version string (confirm CVE-2023-48309 applicability for versions < 4.24.5)
Backend API base URL (likely revops-dev.livelystone-c1480484.westus2.azurecontainerapps.io but confirm)
Any NEXTAUTH_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, or NEXT_PUBLIC_* environment variables leaked in bundles
Hardcoded API keys, tokens, or connection strings
Azure AD clientId, tenantId, or redirect URIs embedded in client-side code
Pusher app key and channel configuration
All internal API route paths (/api/*) referenced in the bundle
Any debug flags or feature flags indicating development/staging mode
Authentication redirect flow logic — does callbackUrl get validated against an allowlist?
success_signals: callbackUrl validation code found (or confirmed absent — open redirect)
NextAuth.js version < 4.24.5 identified in bundle (CVE-2023-48309 confirmed applicable)
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL or hardcoded backend URL extracted
Any API key, secret, or token found in bundle
Azure AD clientId/tenantId extracted from bundle
Pusher app key found
No callbackUrl allowlist found — confirms open redirect candidate
hints.expected_outcome: Extract callbackUrl validation logic and NextAuth.js version to confirm chain_001 CVE applicability; discover hardcoded secrets and backend API surface from Next.js static bundles

focus_resources: NextAuth.js Azure AD provider configuration patterns
OIDC state parameter generation and validation
Nonce claim validation in id_token processing
NEXTAUTH_SECRET entropy and default value patterns
JWT session encoding (HS256 with weak secret vs RS256)
Auth middleware patterns in Express backend
PKCE implementation in authorization code flow
Multi-tenant vs single-tenant Azure AD configuration
analysis_patterns: Missing or predictable state parameter (CSRF in OAuth flow)
Absent nonce validation in OIDC id_token processing
NEXTAUTH_SECRET set to default, short, or common value
Azure AD provider accepting tokens from multiple tenants (multi-tenant misconfiguration)
JWT signed with HS256 using derivable secret (brute-forceable)
Express auth middleware applied selectively vs globally (route coverage gaps)
Missing SameSite=Strict or HttpOnly on session cookies
success_signals: State parameter entropy too low or predictable pattern identified
Nonce validation absent or bypassable in NextAuth Azure AD callback
NEXTAUTH_SECRET identified as weak or default (e.g., 'secret', 'changeme', UUID-format)
Azure AD provider configured as multi-tenant (common_authority endpoint)
Auth middleware gap found — some Express routes lack JWT validation
Session cookie misconfiguration (missing HttpOnly, SameSite=None)
hints.expected_outcome: Identify OIDC state/nonce weaknesses and NEXTAUTH_SECRET strength to assess chain_003 account takeover feasibility; identify auth middleware coverage gaps in Express backend

deprioritize.reason: pay.copointdata.com tech stack still uncharacterized — wave 1 recon will fingerprint only; exploitation chain deferred to wave 2 once stack is known
